name: CreateContainerScanTaskByAppName

parameters.help_en: The name of the container application
parameters.name: app_names

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response.

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en: The data returned if the request was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

CanCreate.description_en:
Indicates whether you can create more scan tasks. Valid values:

true
false
CanCreate.description_zh:
是否可以继续创建扫描任务。取值：

true：可以继续创建扫描任务。
false：无法继续创建扫描任务

CollectTime.description_en: The timestamp generated when the image information was collected. Unit: milliseconds
CollectTime.description_zh: 采集镜像信息的时间戳，单位为毫秒

ExecTime.description_en: The timestamp generated when the scan task started. Unit: milliseconds
ExecTime.description_zh: 扫描任务开始运行的时间戳，单位为毫秒

FinishCount.description_en: The number of container applications that are scanned
FinishCount.description_zh: 已完成扫描的容器的数量

Progress.description_en: The progress of the scan task in percentage
Progress.description_zh: 扫描任务进度的百分比

Result.description_en:
The result of the scan task. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The task is successful.
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION: The task is not supported in the region where the image is deployed
Result.description_zh:
扫描任务的执行结果。取值：

SUCCESS：扫描任务执行成功。
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION：镜像在不支持扫描的地域。

镜像安全扫描支持的地域，请参见本文档返回参数表后的镜像安全扫描支持的地域的表格

Status.description_en:
The status of the scan task. Valid values:

INIT: The task is being initialized.
PRE_ANALYZER: The task is being pre-processed.
SUCCESS: The task succeeds.
FAIL: The task fails
Status.description_zh:
扫描任务的状态。取值：

INIT：初始化中。
PRE_ANALYZER：预分析中。
SUCCESS：执行成功。
FAIL：执行失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the scan task

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of container applications that you want to scan
